name: mumble-voices
description: Synthesised mumble speech for game dialogue: Klatt formant and waveguide vocal-tract engines, no audio files.

scripts.build: tsc && vite build && vite build --mode single
scripts.check: node tools/check-formants.js formant && node tools/check-formants.js tract && node tools/check-levels.js formant && node tools/check-levels.js tract && node tools/scan-clicks.js
